title: Auditable Memory Record
description: A single AI agent memory record per the AMR specification v0.2. Required fields are AMR-Core; required plus all optional fields are AMR-Extended.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record within its store.

type.description: Record type: one of the core types or an x- extension.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact content bytes (UTF-8).

source_ref.description: Reference to the source: file, URL, message.

event_time.description: When the fact became true in the world (ISO 8601 date or timestamp), or the literal 'unknown' when it cannot be determined. Never approximated.

recorded_time.description: When the record was written (ISO 8601 date or timestamp).

status.description: Lifecycle status; history is marked, never deleted.

supersedes.description: id of the record this one replaces.

superseded_by.description: id of the record that replaces this one.

applied.description: Whether redaction ran before the record was persisted.

kinds.description: Kinds of redaction applied, e.g. secret, email, phone.

schema_version.description: AMR specification version the record conforms to.
